issuing_body: 農林水産省 (Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Japan)
covered_actors: ＡＩ研究開発委託者 (AI R&D commissioners)
農業普及指導員等 (agricultural extension officers)
enforcement_authorities: 農林水産省 (Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries)
implementation_notes: This is a contractual guideline (契約ガイドライン) for AI and data use in the agricultural sector, focused on know-how protection and data utilization. It provides model contracts and term sheets for data/know-how provision, AI R&D commissioning, and third-party data sharing. It is non-binding guidance referencing METI AI contract guidelines. No penalties or mandatory compliance dates are specified.
